card.name: Dose limit subject before "should not exceed"
card.fires_on: The last word of a dose-limit subject, such as dose, period, rate or hours, right before "should not exceed". It appears in maximum daily dose statements.

modes.label: Time span noun
modes.description: The noun ending a 24-hour or treatment time span before a limit statement.
modes.example: The total dose for any 24-hour<< period>> should not exceed 1,00

modes.label: Dose or rate noun
modes.description: The word dose, dosage or rate naming the amount that is capped.
modes.example: However, the daily<< dose>> should not exceed 400 mg

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words meaning "should not" or "must not" (不可, 不宜, 勿), which pushes toward a prohibition or limit phrase next.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of a phrase like "total daily dose" just before the text says it should not be exceeded.
